meta.promptText: India mein oily skin ke liye 500 rupees ke andar konsa face wash kharidna chahiye?

response.text:
₹500 ke andar **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid + LHA Face Wash (100 ml)** sabse accha overall choice hai—khaaskar oily, blackheads ya acne-prone skin ke liye. Iski price lagbhag ₹278–₹349 hai aur fragrance-free formula pores aur excess oil ko target karta hai.[2][5]

**Skin concern ke hisaab se options:**

- **Oily + acne/blackheads:** Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid + LHA — ~₹299.[2]
- **Sensitive oily skin:** Simple Kind To Skin Refreshing Face Wash — ~₹224–₹450; ya gentle, fragrance-free cleanser choose karein.[1][7]
- **Normal oily skin, budget option:** Himalaya Purifying Neem Face Wash — ~₹120–₹250.[1][5]
- **Oily + dull skin:** Plum Green Tea Pore Cleansing Face Wash — ~₹239–₹349.[5][7]
- **Oily skin with occasional pimples:** The Derma Co 2% Salicylic Acid Face Wash — ~₹263–₹299.[2]

**Meri recommendation:** Pehli baar ke liye Minimalist ko raat mein **din mein ek baar** use karein; dryness, burning ya redness ho to alternate days kar dein. Face wash ke baad lightweight, non-comedogenic moisturiser aur din mein sunscreen lagayein. Salicylic-acid face wash ko overuse na karein, kyunki skin dry ya irritated ho sakti hai.
